title: Mob Museum Datapack
description: Adds several quality of life changes that ease the collection of different kinds of mods, while keeping it fully vanilla
body:
This datapack aims to ease the collection and holding of every mob currently in Minecraft by adding several quality of life changes.
-Name a Nether Mob "NoZ" to make it not zombify when leaving the nether.
-Name a Wandering Trader / Llama "NoD" to make it not despawn.
-Name a vex "preserve" to hinder it from dying after 5 minutes.
-Name a mob silent to silence them. When naming a warden "silent" it will be unable to attack from that point on. (The silencing feature was heavily inspired by a similar datapack by 
@o-Peepo, credited here)

Join the dc server for updates and suggestions!
